'''Norvaan Kel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chevin/Legends|Chevin]] who served the [[Portho Kaltemmic]] of the [[Three Families]] on [[Quesh]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].
